name: dsh-pet
description: Desktop-pet companion for the DSH web GUI: hatch Codex-compatible sprite pets from an image, render them in the shell.overlay slot, and react to session state.

scripts.build:sample-pet: node .dsh/skills/pet-hatch/build-atlas.mjs --source sample-source.png --name dsh-kitten --display-name "DSH Kitten" --description "A tiny pixel kitten that watches you code." --out sample-pet --format webp
scripts.build:all: node scripts/make-sample-source.mjs && node .dsh/skills/pet-hatch/build-atlas.mjs --source sample-source.png --name dsh-kitten --display-name "DSH Kitten" --description "A tiny pixel kitten that watches you code." --out sample-pet --format webp && node scripts/build-client.mjs
